text:
Sasha: emergency WFH update — set up the old treadmill as a standing station because my office chair exploded. Pics incoming. :running_shirt_with_sash:
Tom: pics or it didn't happen :camera_with_flash:
Sasha: https://img.example.com/treadmill-setup.jpg — laptop on a plywood shelf lashed to the treadmill console, monitor on a mic stand. walking slowly during meetings. feels energizing until the power hiccuped and everything went dark. :zap:
Riley: whoa. treadmill desk + laptop = dedication. did you have a UPS? 
Sasha: yep, thankfully the little UPS kept the router and laptop alive for like 6 minutes. saved the customer demo. :pray:
Tom: PSA: if you run sensitive gear off a treadmill outlet (or any surge-prone circuit), plug the modem into UPS first. treadmill motors cause nasty spikes when they start/stop.
Riley: totally. also, use a power strip with surge and a proper grounded outlet. and maybe secure the plywood — last thing you want is a laptop sliding mid-standup. :sweat_smile:
Sasha: noted. taped the edges and added a non-slip mat. also swapped to the hotspot during the brownout since my ISP went flaky.
infra-bot: FYI: Regional maintenance on broadband-exchange scheduled for 2027-01-12 02:00 UTC could cause short reconnects.
Tom: timing of the universe. 
Sasha: here's the UPS model I used: APC Back-UPS 650 — small but heroic. kept my call alive and gave me time to save docs. :mechanical_arm:
Riley: good buy. also consider a powered ethernet passthrough if you ever need to move farther from the router — travel router + ethernet = stable signal.
Sasha: bookmarked. next iteration: add a clamp lamp and a cup-holder for electrolytes. any suggestions for cable management on a treadmill? 
Tom: zip ties + spiral wrap. avoid anything that dangles near the belt.
Riley: secret tip: set your walking speed low (1.5–2.0 mph) for calls. keeps energy without turning your voice into Alvin. :chipmunk:
sticker-bot: :thumbsup: added a sticker to Sasha's photo
Sasha: thanks team — demo survived, spine mostly intact. will post a before/after montage later. :tada:
